design.unit: surveyed woman, not certified unique household
design.population: accepted nonprobability leader-enumerator contact/referral and household-remittance account; preserve historical exclusions and verification limits

primary: P1: q6_13 digital retention/use; original categories plus accepted binary
P2: q6_14 recent domestic digital participation
supporting: S3: perceived safety and agency-related reports
proposed_hierarchy.remaining: descriptive/contextual/measurement-validation evidence; no automatic regression per item
proposed_hierarchy.typology: optional conditional contribution; no-LCA remains available

model_preparation.proposed_family: binary logit for the two proposed binary engagement outcomes, subject to owner adoption and support
model_preparation.proposed_reporting: unadjusted original-category distributions and binary prevalence; adjusted probabilities/average marginal effects with pointwise 95% intervals if adopted; retain coefficient/native evidence
fit_slots_proposed: P1 at most one nominated substantive extension
P2 at most one nominated substantive extension
model_preparation.scope_limit: Four slots are a planning envelope only, not executable commands or an approved fit ceiling; sensitivity fits and margins need their own exact grants.

context_candidate_pool.recommended_form: source categories, not automatic cardinal points
not latest-return tenure; source and functional form pending

model_preparation.rule: No fit until exact contrasts, covariates, reference levels, sample, covariance and comparison families are owner-adopted. Do not select by observed significance, event counts or convenience; use coverage evidence to propose an explicit amendment when needed.
restrictions: Do not simultaneously adjust IVS and its constituents without an explicit interpretation.
Do not call raw and standardized historical equations simple rescalings when their predictors differ.
No automatic RDS weights, inferred household links, city/enumerator clustering or universal complete-case sample.
Generic robust standard errors do not solve unrecorded network/recruitment dependence or create national inference.
No automatic imputation, interaction grid, stepwise selection or category pooling.

D6.admissibility: source/route/domain conformity; fixed accepted recipe; finite declared comparisons; coverage and uncertainty limits; no unexpected sample change
D6.historical_parity: exact historical targets remain separate from candidate-definition differences and scientific closeness
D6.precision: exact category mappings and declared computational precision; no tolerance widening to conceal a mismatch
D6.rule_for_unresolved_support: hold inferential comparison and report its limitation; no automatic collapse/exclusion or change to the original answers
D6.public_display: exact derivative/package disclosure review, no release implied

LCA.prior_twelve_fit_wave: existing conditional proposal: one justified family, k2-k5, three separately fixed schedules; not approved here and not proof that three schedules are sufficient
required_before_manifest: adopt a coherent indicator family or decide no academic LCA
fix sample/outcome space, missingness and version rules
justify class counts, seed schedules, starts, iterations and finite time/capacity limits
fix comparison coordinates/tolerances, label-matching and failure dispositions
plan separately authorized probability uncertainty, local-dependence and sparse/boundary checks
validate exact runtime/version and downstream classification-error method feasibility
forbidden_inferences: AIC/BIC from different observed outcome spaces or samples can be ranked directly
dispositions: revised family under a new contract
LCA.downstream: choose an appropriate uncertainty-aware approach only after software/method feasibility; no assumed BCH/three-step compatibility

owner_decision_bundles: B: nominated substantive contrasts and finite adjusted/extension slots
C: exact covariates, reference levels, geography/time definitions and uncertainty
D: finite comparisons, multiplicity/reporting and support rules
E: conditional LCA route and admissibility or no-LCA disposition
F: exact protected-use input/output/operational permission for the no-fit contract

official_sources_checked.scope: current binary logit documentation, not historical runtime validation
current margins capabilities, not executed or validated for historical Stata16
cross-sectional reporting aid, not claimed journal mandate or achieved compliance
